question: K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) . K sits second to the right of L. N sits third to the left of K. P is not an immediate neighbour of K. O sits second to the left of M. What is the position of O with respect to K?
solution:
K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

• N sits third to the left of K.
 
• P is not an immediate neighbour of K.
 
• O sits second to the left of M.
